comment: restore.c restgamestate():704-705 gh.hero_seq = svm.moves << 3, for a hero saved after her second action of one move. A debug-mode Samurai, intrinsically fast, wishes for a stethoscope (item f) and searches seven times; the seventh search leaves the turn counter at 7, so allmain.c moveloop_core():396 has counted two hero actions in that move and hero_seq is moves * 8 + 2. He listens to himself (apply.c use_stethoscope():340-341, free) and saves. The second segment dismisses the welcome --More--, declines to keep the save file, and applies the stethoscope twice: the first use is free again because the restored hero_seq is moves * 8, and the second takes a move. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
